sw.L: Jitunzeni nafsi zenu na kundi lote, ambalo ndani yake Roho Mtakatifu amewaweka ninyi kuwa waangalizi, mlichunge kanisa la Mungu, alilojipatia kwa damu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} mwenyewe.
sw.B: Jihadharini nafsi zenu na kundi lote ambalo ndani yake Roho Mtakatifu amewaweka kuwa waangalizi, ili mlichunge kanisa la Mungu, alilojipatia kwa damu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} mwenyewe.
sw.R: Muwe waangalifu jinsi mnavyoishi, na mwaangalie waumini wote, walio kama kundi la kondoo. Roho Mtakatifu amewaweka ninyi kuwa viongozi wa kuwaangalia. Litunzeni kanisa la Mungu kama mchungaji anavyowatunza kondoo wake. Mungu alilinunua kwa damu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} mwenyewe.

decisions.choice: SBLGNT: "the church of God"
alternatives: "the church of the Lord and God"
decisions.reason: Some of the oldest manuscripts, among them Codex Sinaiticus and Codex Vaticanus, read "of God". Others, among them Codex Alexandrinus and Codex Bezae, read "of the Lord", and many later ones combine the two. "Of God" with "his own blood" is the harder reading, which copyists may have softened; "of the Lord" is also early. Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: through his own blood
alternatives: through the blood of his own [one], that is, his own Son
decisions.reason: The words can be read either way. Their order is the usual way of saying "his own blood", and the blood is the blood of Christ. But "his own" alone was used for a dear one, and Paul says God did not spare his own Son (Romans 8:32); read that way, the phrase names the Son. Some manuscripts change the order to "the own blood", which allows only the first reading.

decisions.choice: overseers: the elders of 20:17, who watch over the church
decisions.reason: Paul calls the same men elders (20:17) and overseers. The word means one who looks after others; later it became the title "bishop" (Philippians 1:1; 1 Timothy 3:1-2; Titus 1:5-7).

decisions.choice: flock and shepherd: God's people and those who care for them
decisions.reason: The picture comes from the Old Testament (Ezekiel 34) and from Jesus (John 10:11; 21:16); compare 1 Peter 5:2-3.

decisions.choice: acquired: won for himself, made his own at a cost
decisions.reason: The verb means to gain or secure for oneself (1 Timothy 3:13).

decisions.choice: be careful how you live; who are like a flock of sheep; as a shepherd cares for sheep
alternatives: take heed to yourselves and to the flock; to shepherd
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of flock and shepherd.

decisions.choice: paid for it
decisions.reason: Readable says that the church was gained at the cost of blood.

decisions.choice: supervisores (L, B); líderes de la iglesia (R)
decisions.reason: The term-sheet rendering: "obispos" would suggest a later church office over many congregations, while these are the elders of 20:17 (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: surveillants (L, B); responsables (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet settles for the overseer word. "Évêques" would suggest the later office of a bishop over many churches; here the overseers are the elders of 20:17 (m3).

decisions.choice: l’Église de Dieu, with a capital
decisions.reason: The elders of one city are to shepherd God's people, which God made his own at the cost of blood (m5); the phrase names the whole church, so it takes the capital, unlike "l’église" of Ephesus in 20:17.

decisions.choice: waangalizi (L, B); viongozi wa kuwaangalia (R)
decisions.reason: "maaskofu" (bishops) names a later church office; "waangalizi" says what the elders of 20:17 were set to do, watch over the church. Readable makes clear they are its leaders, as the project's terms for episkopos do.

source.text: ἐγὼ οἶδα ὅτι εἰσελεύσονται μετὰ τὴν ἄφιξίν μου λύκοι βαρεῖς εἰς ὑμᾶς μὴ φειδόμενοι τοῦ ποιμνίου, καὶ ἐξ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν ἀναστήσονται ἄνδρες λαλοῦντες διεστραμμένα τοῦ ἀποσπᾶν τοὺς μαθητὰς ὀπίσω ἑαυτῶν·

records.literal_gloss: I know that will come in after the departure of me wolves savage into you not sparing the flock, \v 30 and from you yourselves will rise up men speaking perverted things to draw away the disciples after themselves.

en.L: I know that after my departure savage wolves will come in among you, not sparing the flock, \v 30 and from among your own selves men will arise speaking perverted things, to draw away the disciples after them.
en.B: Once I have gone, I know, savage wolves will force their way in among you, with no mercy for the flock. \v 30 And from your own ranks {{gender:people|men}} will stand up and speak twisted things, to lure the disciples into following them.
en.R: I know that after I leave, people will come among you who are like savage wolves. They will attack the flock and will not spare it. \v 30 Even some {{gender:people|men}} from your own group will begin to teach things that are twisted and false. They will try to get the followers of Jesus to follow them instead.

es.L: Yo sé que después de mi partida entrarán entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} lobos feroces que no perdonarán al rebaño, \v 30 y de entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} mismos se levantarán hombres que hablarán cosas perversas para arrastrar a los discípulos tras sí.
es.B: Sé que, cuando me haya ido, lobos feroces se meterán entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} sin ninguna compasión del rebaño. \v 30 Y de entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} mismos se levantarán {{gender:personas|hombres}} que dirán cosas retorcidas para atraer a los discípulos y hacer que los sigan a ellos.
es.R: Sé que, cuando me vaya, vendrán entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} personas que son como lobos feroces. Atacarán al rebaño y no tendrán compasión de él. \v 30 Incluso {{gender:algunas personas|algunos hombres}} de entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} empezarán a enseñar cosas retorcidas y falsas. Tratarán de que los discípulos de Jesús los sigan a ellos.

fr.L: Je sais qu’après mon départ entreront parmi vous des loups féroces, qui n’épargneront pas le troupeau, \v 30 et que du milieu de vous-mêmes se lèveront des hommes qui diront des choses perverties pour entraîner les disciples à leur suite.
fr.B: Une fois que je serai parti, je le sais, des loups féroces s’introduiront chez vous et n’auront aucune pitié du troupeau. \v 30 Et de vos propres rangs se lèveront {{gender:des personnes|des hommes}} qui tiendront des discours tordus pour entraîner les disciples à les suivre.
fr.R: Je sais qu’après mon départ, des gens viendront parmi vous, et ils seront comme des loups féroces. Ils attaqueront le troupeau et ne l’épargneront pas. \v 30 Même parmi vous, {{gender:certaines personnes|certains hommes}} se mettront à enseigner des choses tordues et fausses. Ces gens-là essaieront d’amener ceux qui suivent Jésus à les suivre, eux, à la place.

sw.L: Mimi najua kwamba baada ya kuondoka kwangu mbwa mwitu wakali wataingia kati yenu, wasilihurumie kundi; \v 30 na kutoka miongoni mwenu wenyewe watainuka watu wakinena mambo yaliyopotoka, ili kuwavuta wanafunzi wawafuate wao.
sw.B: Ninajua kwamba nikishaondoka, mbwa mwitu wakali watavamia kati yenu, bila kulihurumia kundi. \v 30 Hata kutoka miongoni mwenu wenyewe watainuka watu watakaosema mambo yaliyopotoka, ili kuwavuta wanafunzi wawafuate.
sw.R: Ninajua kwamba baada ya mimi kuondoka, watu walio kama mbwa mwitu wakali watakuja kati yenu. Watalishambulia kundi bila huruma. \v 30 Hata baadhi ya watu kutoka kundi lenu wenyewe wataanza kufundisha mambo yaliyopotoka na ya uongo. Watajaribu kuwavuta wanafunzi wa Yesu wawafuate wao badala yake.

decisions.choice: savage wolves: people who will harm the church
decisions.reason: Jesus warned of false prophets who are wolves (Matthew 7:15) and of the wolf that scatters the flock (John 10:12).

decisions.choice: savage: fierce, dangerous
decisions.reason: The word means heavy, and so harsh or cruel.

decisions.choice: from among yourselves: from inside the church, even its leaders
decisions.reason: The second danger is set against the first: the wolves come in, these rise up from within.

decisions.choice: men: people from within the church
decisions.reason: The word is the one for men. Paul is speaking to the elders, who were men, but his point is that the danger will come from inside the church.

decisions.choice: people, with "men" as the alternative; Literal keeps "men"
decisions.reason: The meaning note leaves open whether only men are meant.

decisions.choice: people ... who are like savage wolves; twisted and false
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture and what twisted things are.

decisions.choice: hombres (L); {{gender:personas|hombres}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in English: the word may mean the men among the leaders, but the point is people from within the church (meaning decision m4), so Balanced and Readable have the gender setting and Literal keeps "hombres". In Readable the span takes in "algunas", which agrees with the noun.

decisions.choice: watu, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The word means people from within the church (meaning decision on men). Swahili "watu" already includes men and women, and "wanaume" would say males only, so every level has "watu" and no gender span, unlike the English.

source.text: διὸ γρηγορεῖτε, μνημονεύοντες ὅτι τριετίαν νύκτα καὶ ἡμέραν οὐκ ἐπαυσάμην μετὰ δακρύων νουθετῶν ἕνα ἕκαστον.

records.literal_gloss: Therefore be watchful, remembering that three years night and day not I ceased with tears admonishing one each.

en.L: Therefore be watchful, remembering that for three years, night and day, I did not cease admonishing each one with tears.
en.B: So be watchful, and remember: for three years I did not stop, night or day, admonishing each one of you with tears.
en.R: So be on guard! Remember that for three years I warned each one of you, day and night. I never stopped, and I often cried as I warned you.

es.L: Por tanto, {{plural_you:velen|velad}}, recordando que durante tres años, noche y día, no cesé de amonestar con lágrimas a cada uno.
es.B: Así que {{plural_you:estén|estad}} alerta, y {{plural_you:recuerden|recordad}} que durante tres años, de noche y de día, no dejé de amonestar con lágrimas a cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: ¡Así que {{plural_you:estén|estad}} alerta! {{plural_you:Recuerden|Recordad}} que durante tres años, de día y de noche, {{plural_you:les|os}} advertí a cada uno. Nunca dejé de hacerlo, y muchas veces lloré al {{plural_you:advertirles|advertiros}}.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi veillez, vous souvenant que, pendant trois ans, nuit et jour, je n’ai pas cessé d’avertir chacun avec larmes.
fr.B: Soyez donc vigilants, et souvenez-vous : pendant trois ans, nuit et jour, je n’ai cessé d’avertir chacun de vous avec des larmes.
fr.R: Alors restez sur vos gardes ! Souvenez-vous que pendant trois ans, j’ai averti chacun de vous, jour et nuit. Je ne me suis jamais arrêté, et j’ai souvent pleuré en vous avertissant.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo kesheni, mkikumbuka kwamba kwa miaka mitatu, usiku na mchana, sikuacha kumwonya kila mmoja kwa machozi.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo kaeni macho, na mkumbuke kwamba kwa miaka mitatu sikuacha, usiku wala mchana, kumwonya kila mmoja wenu kwa machozi.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo kaeni macho! Kumbukeni kwamba kwa miaka mitatu nilimwonya kila mmoja wenu, mchana na usiku. Sikuacha kamwe, na mara nyingi nililia nilipowaonya.

decisions.choice: be watchful: stay awake and alert
decisions.reason: The verb means to keep awake, and so to be on guard (Mark 13:35-37).

decisions.choice: three years: his whole stay at Ephesus
decisions.reason: 19:8 and 19:10 give three months and two years, and more time followed (19:22). Parts of years were counted as whole years.

decisions.choice: admonishing: warning and correcting
decisions.reason: The word is used of warning someone for their good (1 Thessalonians 5:14).

decisions.choice: velad (L); estad alerta (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term-sheet rendering for this verb: Literal keeps "velar", to stay awake, the verb's first sense (meaning decision m1); Balanced and Readable use the everyday "estar alerta".

source.text: καὶ τὰ νῦν παρατίθεμαι ὑμᾶς τῷ θεῷ καὶ τῷ λόγῳ τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ, τῷ δυναμένῳ οἰκοδομῆσαι καὶ δοῦναι τὴν κληρονομίαν ἐν τοῖς ἡγιασμένοις πᾶσιν.

records.literal_gloss: And now I entrust you to the God and to the word of the grace of him, the [one] being able to build up and to give the inheritance among the having been sanctified all.

en.L: And now I entrust you to God and to the word of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace, which is able to build [you] up and to give [you] the inheritance among all those who have been sanctified.
en.B: And now I place you in the care of God and of the message of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace. That message has power to build you up and to give you your share among all who have been made holy.
en.R: Now I am putting you into God's care, and I trust you to the message of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace. This message can make you strong. It can give you what God has promised to all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy people.

es.L: Y ahora {{plural_you:los|os}} confío a Dios y a la palabra de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia, que puede {{plural_you:edificarlos|edificaros}} y {{plural_you:darles|daros}} la herencia entre todos los santificados.
es.B: Y ahora {{plural_you:los|os}} pongo en manos de Dios y del mensaje de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia. Ese mensaje tiene poder para {{plural_you:edificarlos|edificaros}} y para {{plural_you:darles|daros}} la parte que {{plural_you:les|os}} corresponde entre todos los que han sido hechos santos.
es.R: Ahora {{plural_you:los|os}} pongo al cuidado de Dios, y {{plural_you:los|os}} confío al mensaje de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia. Este mensaje puede {{plural_you:fortalecerlos|fortaleceros}}. Puede {{plural_you:darles|daros}} lo que Dios ha prometido a todo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo santo.

fr.L: Et maintenant je vous confie à Dieu et à la parole de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce, qui peut [vous] édifier et [vous] donner l’héritage parmi tous ceux qui ont été sanctifiés.
fr.B: Et maintenant, je vous remets entre les mains de Dieu et du message de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce. Ce message a le pouvoir de vous faire grandir et de vous donner votre part avec tous ceux qui ont été rendus saints.
fr.R: Maintenant, je vous confie à Dieu, et je vous confie au message de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce. Ce message peut vous rendre forts. Il peut vous donner ce que Dieu a promis à tout {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple saint.

sw.L: Na sasa nawakabidhi kwa Mungu na kwa neno la neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, linaloweza kuwajenga na kuwapa urithi miongoni mwa wote waliotakaswa.
sw.B: Na sasa nawaweka mikononi mwa Mungu na mwa ujumbe wa neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Ujumbe huo una uwezo wa kuwajenga na kuwapa sehemu yenu ya urithi pamoja na wote waliofanywa watakatifu.
sw.R: Sasa nawakabidhi mikononi mwa Mungu, na ninawaachia ujumbe wa neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Ujumbe huu unaweza kuwafanya imara. Unaweza kuwapa yale ambayo Mungu ameahidi kuwapa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote walio watakatifu.

decisions.choice: which is able: the word of his grace
decisions.reason: The words "being able" follow "the word" most closely, and God's word builds up (compare James 1:21). But they could also go back to God, as in Romans 16:25 and Jude 24.

decisions.choice: SBLGNT: "to God"
decisions.reason: Both readings are early. Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: inheritance: a share in what God gives his people
decisions.reason: As Israel received a share of the land, believers have a share among God's people (26:18; Colossians 1:12).

decisions.choice: sanctified: set apart for God, made holy
decisions.reason: The same phrase is used in 26:18.

decisions.choice: what God has promised to all his holy people
alternatives: the inheritance among all who are sanctified
decisions.reason: Readable explains inheritance and sanctified in plain words.

decisions.choice: edificarlos ... darles, unbracketed
decisions.reason: Spanish joins the object pronoun to the infinitive, so Literal cannot bracket it as the English Literal brackets "[you]"; the pronoun is written in full.

source.text: ἀργυρίου ἢ χρυσίου ἢ ἱματισμοῦ οὐδενὸς ἐπεθύμησα·

records.literal_gloss: Silver or gold or clothing of no one I coveted.

en.L: I coveted no one's silver or gold or clothing.
en.B: I never set my heart on anyone's silver or gold or clothing.
en.R: I never wanted anyone's money or fine clothes.

es.L: Plata u oro o ropa de nadie codicié.
es.B: Nunca he codiciado la plata, el oro ni la ropa de nadie.
es.R: Nunca quise el dinero ni la ropa fina de nadie.

fr.L: Je n’ai convoité l’argent ni l’or ni les vêtements de personne.
fr.B: Je n’ai jamais désiré l’argent, l’or ou les vêtements de qui que ce soit.
fr.R: Je n’ai jamais eu envie de l’argent ni des beaux habits de personne.

sw.L: Sikutamani fedha wala dhahabu wala mavazi ya mtu yeyote.
sw.B: Sikuwahi kuitamani fedha au dhahabu au mavazi ya mtu yeyote.
sw.R: Sikuwahi kutaka pesa au nguo nzuri za mtu yeyote.

decisions.choice: silver, gold, clothing: the forms wealth took
decisions.reason: Fine clothing was a store of wealth (Joshua 7:21; James 5:2).

decisions.choice: an echo of Samuel's farewell
decisions.reason: Samuel, leaving his office, asked whose ox or donkey he had taken (1 Samuel 12:3). The likeness is general.

decisions.choice: money or fine clothes
decisions.reason: Readable says what silver and gold meant: money.

decisions.choice: l’argent (R), without "l’or"
decisions.reason: French "argent" means both silver and money, so Readable can say "money" as the English does with the same word the other levels use for silver.

source.text: αὐτοὶ γινώσκετε ὅτι ταῖς χρείαις μου καὶ τοῖς οὖσι μετ’ ἐμοῦ ὑπηρέτησαν αἱ χεῖρες αὗται.

records.literal_gloss: Yourselves you know that to the needs of me and to those being with me served the hands these.

en.L: You yourselves know that these hands served my needs and [those of] the ones who were with me.
en.B: You know yourselves that I provided for my own needs, and for those who were with me, with these hands.
en.R: You know that I worked with my own hands to earn what I needed. I also earned what the people with me needed.

es.L: {{plural_you:Ustedes mismos saben|Vosotros mismos sabéis}} que a mis necesidades y [a las de] los que estaban conmigo sirvieron estas manos.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes mismos saben|Vosotros mismos sabéis}} que con estas manos he provisto para mis propias necesidades y las de los que estaban conmigo.
es.R: {{plural_you:Saben|Sabéis}} que trabajé con mis propias manos para ganar lo que necesitaba. También gané lo que necesitaban los que estaban conmigo.

fr.L: Vous savez vous-mêmes que ces mains ont pourvu à mes besoins et [à ceux] de ceux qui étaient avec moi.
fr.B: Vous savez vous-mêmes que j’ai pourvu à mes besoins et à ceux de mes compagnons avec ces mains que voici.
fr.R: Vous savez que j’ai travaillé de mes propres mains pour gagner ce dont j’avais besoin. J’ai aussi gagné ce dont avaient besoin les gens qui étaient avec moi.

sw.L: Ninyi wenyewe mnajua kwamba mikono hii ilihudumia mahitaji yangu na ya wale waliokuwa pamoja nami.
sw.B: Ninyi wenyewe mnajua kwamba kwa mikono hii nilijipatia mahitaji yangu, na ya wale waliokuwa pamoja nami.
sw.R: Mnajua kwamba nilifanya kazi kwa mikono yangu mwenyewe kupata nilichohitaji. Pia nilipata kile walichohitaji watu waliokuwa pamoja nami.

decisions.choice: these hands: Paul's own work as a tentmaker
decisions.reason: Paul worked at his trade in Corinth (18:3), and speaks of it in 1 Corinthians 4:12 and 1 Thessalonians 2:9. "These" suggests he showed them his hands.

decisions.choice: those with me: his fellow workers
decisions.reason: Paul's companions, such as those named in 20:4 and 19:22.

decisions.choice: I provided ... with these hands
decisions.reason: Balanced makes Paul the subject and keeps "these hands" to the end for emphasis.

source.text: πάντα ὑπέδειξα ὑμῖν ὅτι οὕτως κοπιῶντας δεῖ ἀντιλαμβάνεσθαι τῶν ἀσθενούντων, μνημονεύειν τε τῶν λόγων τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ ὅτι αὐτὸς εἶπεν Μακάριόν ἐστιν μᾶλλον διδόναι ἢ λαμβάνειν.

records.literal_gloss: All things I showed you that thus laboring it is necessary to help the being weak, to remember and the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, Blessed it is more to give than to receive.

en.L: In all things I showed you that by laboring like this we must help the weak, and remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} said, 'It is more blessed to give than to receive.'"
en.B: In every way I set you an example: by working hard like this we must come to the aid of the weak, and keep in mind the words of the Lord Jesus, how {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} said, 'It is more blessed to give than to receive.'"
en.R: In all I did, I showed you that we must work hard like this and help people who are weak or in need. We must remember what the Lord Jesus {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} said: 'Giving brings more blessing than receiving.'"

es.L: En todo {{plural_you:les|os}} mostré que, trabajando así, es necesario ayudar a los débiles y recordar las palabras del Señor Jesús, que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mismo dijo: “Más dichoso es dar que recibir”».
es.B: En todo {{plural_you:les|os}} di ejemplo de que, trabajando duro de este modo, debemos socorrer a los débiles y tener presentes las palabras del Señor Jesús, cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mismo dijo: “Es más dichoso dar que recibir”».
es.R: Con todo lo que hice, {{plural_you:les|os}} mostré que debemos trabajar duro así y ayudar a los que están débiles o necesitados. Debemos recordar lo que dijo el Señor Jesús mismo: “Dar trae más bendición que recibir”».

fr.L: En tout je vous ai montré qu’en peinant ainsi il faut secourir les faibles et se souvenir des paroles du Seigneur Jésus, car c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} qui a dit : “Il est plus heureux de donner que de recevoir.” »
fr.B: En toutes choses, je vous ai donné l’exemple : c’est en travaillant dur ainsi qu’il faut venir en aide aux faibles et garder en mémoire les paroles du Seigneur Jésus, qui a dit {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} : “Donner rend plus heureux que recevoir.” »
fr.R: En tout ce que j’ai fait, je vous ai montré que nous devons travailler dur comme cela et aider les gens qui sont faibles ou dans le besoin. Nous devons nous souvenir de ce que le Seigneur Jésus a dit {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} : “Donner apporte plus de bénédiction que recevoir.” »

sw.L: Katika mambo yote niliwaonyesha kwamba kwa kujitaabisha hivi imetupasa kuwasaidia walio dhaifu, na kuyakumbuka maneno ya Bwana Yesu, kwamba {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} alisema, 'Kutoa kuna heri zaidi kuliko kupokea.'"
sw.B: Kwa kila njia nimewaonyesha mfano: kwa kufanya kazi kwa bidii hivi, ni lazima tuwasaidie walio dhaifu, na tuyakumbuke maneno ya Bwana Yesu, jinsi {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} alivyosema, 'Kutoa kuna heri kubwa zaidi kuliko kupokea.'"
sw.R: Katika yote niliyofanya, niliwaonyesha kwamba ni lazima tufanye kazi kwa bidii namna hii na kuwasaidia watu walio dhaifu au wenye shida. Ni lazima tukumbuke maneno ambayo Bwana Yesu {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} alisema: 'Kutoa huleta baraka nyingi kuliko kupokea.'"

decisions.choice: we must: a duty that binds Paul and his hearers alike
decisions.reason: The verb names no subject; it states what is necessary for everyone in the elders' place.

decisions.choice: the weak: those in need, whether poor or sick
decisions.reason: With working hard and giving, the context points to people who cannot provide for themselves.

decisions.choice: a saying of Jesus not recorded in the Gospels
decisions.reason: The words are not found in the four Gospels, though Jesus taught similar things (Luke 6:38, 14:12-14). Paul passes it on as words of Jesus himself.

decisions.choice: blessed: happy, favored by God
decisions.reason: The word of the Beatitudes (Luke 6:20-22).

decisions.choice: Giving brings more blessing than receiving.
alternatives: It is more blessed to give than to receive.
decisions.reason: Readable puts the saying in plainer words.

decisions.choice: weak or in need
decisions.reason: Readable follows the meaning note.

decisions.choice: dichoso
decisions.reason: The term-sheet word for this Greek adjective (meaning decision m4); "bienaventurado" is now old-fashioned. Readable follows the English Readable's "brings more blessing".

decisions.choice: el Señor Jesús mismo, no span
decisions.reason: Where the English Readable marks "himself" after the name, Spanish "mismo" is an adjective agreeing with "Jesús", not a pronoun, so it takes no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: Il est plus heureux de donner (L); Donner rend plus heureux (B); Donner apporte plus de bénédiction (R)
alternatives: Il y a plus de bonheur à donner qu’à recevoir
decisions.reason: The familiar French wording of this saying belongs to existing versions, so it is drafted afresh from the Greek. "Heureux" renders the blessing word as the Beatitudes do in French (m4); Readable follows the English "more blessing" with "bénédiction".

decisions.choice: car c’est lui-même qui a dit
decisions.reason: French cannot hang the quotation on the relative "that" after "the words" as the Greek does; "car c’est lui-même qui" introduces it and keeps the stress on Jesus himself.

decisions.choice: Kutoa kuna heri zaidi kuliko kupokea
decisions.reason: "heri" for blessed, as in the Beatitudes, with the giving put first; the wording avoids the phrasing of the familiar Swahili versions. Readable says "brings more blessing", as the English Readable does.

source.text: Καὶ ταῦτα εἰπὼν θεὶς τὰ γόνατα αὐτοῦ σὺν πᾶσιν αὐτοῖς προσηύξατο.

records.literal_gloss: And these things having said, having placed the knees of him with all them he prayed.

en.L: And having said these things, he knelt down with them all and prayed.
en.B: After saying this, he knelt down and prayed with them all.
en.R: After Paul said these things, he got down on his knees and prayed with all of them.

es.L: Y habiendo dicho estas cosas, puso sus rodillas [en tierra] y oró con todos ellos.
es.B: Dicho esto, se arrodilló y oró con todos.
es.R: Cuando Pablo terminó de hablar, se arrodilló y oró junto con todos ellos.

fr.L: Et ayant dit ces choses, s’étant mis à genoux, il pria avec eux tous.
fr.B: Après avoir ainsi parlé, il se mit à genoux et pria avec eux tous.
fr.R: Quand Paul a eu fini de parler, il s’est mis à genoux et il a prié avec eux tous.

sw.L: Na akiisha kusema hayo, alipiga magoti pamoja nao wote, akaomba.
sw.B: Baada ya kusema hayo, alipiga magoti, akaomba pamoja nao wote.
sw.R: Paulo alipomaliza kusema mambo hayo, alipiga magoti, akaomba pamoja na wote.

decisions.choice: knelt: a posture of earnest prayer
decisions.reason: Standing was the usual posture for prayer; kneeling marks deep need (7:60, 9:40, 21:5; Luke 22:41).

decisions.choice: Paul
decisions.reason: Readable names the speaker at the end of the speech.

source.text: ἱκανὸς δὲ κλαυθμὸς ἐγένετο πάντων, καὶ ἐπιπεσόντες ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλον τοῦ Παύλου κατεφίλουν αὐτόν, ὀδυνώμενοι μάλιστα ἐπὶ τῷ λόγῳ ᾧ εἰρήκει ὅτι οὐκέτι μέλλουσιν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ θεωρεῖν.

records.literal_gloss: Much then weeping there was of all, and having fallen on the neck of the Paul they were kissing him, \v 38 grieving most at the word which he had spoken, that no longer they are going the face of him to see.

en.L: And there was much weeping among them all, and falling on Paul's neck, they kissed him again and again, \v 38 grieving most of all over the word that he had spoken, that they were no longer going to see his face.
en.B: They all wept freely. They threw their arms around Paul and kissed him again and again. \v 38 Above all, they were pained by what he had said, that they would not see his face any more.
en.R: Everyone cried. They hugged Paul and kissed him. \v 38 They were very sad, most of all because he had said that they would never see him again.

es.L: Y se produjo mucho llanto de todos, y cayendo sobre el cuello de Pablo lo besaban una y otra vez, \v 38 afligidos sobre todo por la palabra que había dicho, de que ya no iban a contemplar su rostro.
es.B: Todos lloraron mucho. Abrazaron a Pablo y lo besaron una y otra vez. \v 38 Lo que más les dolía era lo que había dicho: que ya no volverían a ver su rostro.
es.R: Todos lloraban. Abrazaron a Pablo y lo besaron. \v 38 Estaban muy tristes, sobre todo porque él les había dicho que nunca más lo volverían a ver.

fr.L: Et il y eut beaucoup de pleurs parmi eux tous, et, se jetant au cou de Paul, ils l’embrassaient, \v 38 affligés surtout par la parole qu’il avait dite, qu’ils ne verraient plus son visage.
fr.B: Tous se mirent à pleurer abondamment. Ils se jetèrent au cou de Paul et le couvrirent de baisers. \v 38 Ce qui les peinait le plus, c’était ce qu’il avait dit : ils ne reverraient plus son visage.
fr.R: Tout le monde pleurait. Ils ont serré Paul dans leurs bras et ils l’ont embrassé. \v 38 Ils étaient très tristes, surtout parce qu’il avait dit qu’ils ne le reverraient jamais.

sw.L: Na kukawa na kilio kingi cha wote, na wakimwangukia Paulo shingoni walikuwa wakimbusu, \v 38 wakihuzunika hasa kwa sababu ya neno alilokuwa amesema, kwamba hawataona uso wake tena.
sw.B: Wote walilia sana. Wakamkumbatia Paulo, wakambusu tena na tena. \v 38 Zaidi ya yote, walihuzunishwa na maneno aliyokuwa amesema, kwamba hawangeuona uso wake tena.
sw.R: Kila mtu alilia. Walimkumbatia Paulo na kumbusu. \v 38 Walihuzunika sana, hasa kwa sababu alikuwa amesema kwamba hawangemwona tena kamwe.

decisions.choice: fell on his neck and kissed him: a farewell embrace
decisions.reason: As when the father met the lost son (Luke 15:20) and Joseph met his brothers (Genesis 45:14-15).

decisions.choice: kissed: again and again
decisions.reason: The imperfect tense pictures repeated action.

decisions.choice: the word: his statement in 20:25
decisions.reason: They repeat what he said in 20:25.

decisions.choice: hugged
decisions.reason: Readable uses the plain word for the gesture.

source.text: προέπεμπον δὲ αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον.

records.literal_gloss: They were accompanying then him to the ship.

en.L: And they accompanied him to the ship.
en.B: Then they went with him down to the ship.
en.R: Then they walked with him to the ship.

es.L: Y lo acompañaban hasta el barco.
es.B: Luego lo acompañaron hasta el barco.
es.R: Después fueron con él hasta el barco.

fr.L: Et ils l’accompagnèrent jusqu’au bateau.
fr.B: Puis ils descendirent avec lui jusqu’au bateau.
fr.R: Puis ils ont marché avec lui jusqu’au bateau.

sw.L: Na wakamsindikiza mpaka melini.
sw.B: Kisha wakaenda pamoja naye mpaka kwenye meli.
sw.R: Kisha walitembea pamoja naye mpaka kwenye meli.

decisions.choice: accompanied: escorted him on his way
decisions.reason: The verb is used of seeing travelers off (15:3, 21:5).
